state_reads: current typed Flanking instances on attacker and blocker
timing: all multiplayer block declarations finish before triggers are placed
choices: each controller orders simultaneous triggers through the ordinary APNAP trigger subsystem
apnap: all occurrences from one sealed transition are grouped once in APNAP order
layers: the resolving -1/-1 modifier is an identity-locked layer 7c effect until end of turn
copy: only trusted typed current ability fragments participate
control_change: the source controller at trigger creation controls the triggered ability
zone_change: a changed affected-object logical identity receives no modifier
source_leaves: the trigger uses its source snapshot and may still modify a qualifying blocker after the attacker leaves

variants: one occurrence per attacker instance and qualifying blocker
known_blockers: conditional and rules-text-equivalent Flanking wording remains unsupported
granted, copied, and face-down Flanking requires trusted typed ability fragments
multi-attacker blocking and trigger-doubling policies remain outside this bounded capability
